$comment: The application's capability policy for the account-agent route: which of the tools fernway-api proposes the model may be offered, to whom, and the scope rule each call must satisfy. Each grant pins the server's input schema by SHA-256 of its canonical JSON, and uses the policy's own description rather than the server's, so a server that changes a tool loses it until someone reviews the change. Only this policy emits governance.capabilities (R-15); the guard checks every call before it reaches the server.

list_webhooks.description: List the signed-in workspace's webhooks with their URL and status. workspace is the workspace id from the account details.

get_webhook.description: Get one of the signed-in workspace's webhooks: its events, status, recent failures and the last response its endpoint returned.

enable_webhook.description: Turn one of the signed-in workspace's disabled webhooks back on. Use it only when the user asks for it.

never.delete_webhook: Deletes data that cannot be restored. A person does this in Settings, not the assistant.
